backtest_protocol.execution_model: IBIT, QQQ, SPY, and fixed crypto-equity candidate features are computed from OHLCV rows with Date <= signal_date. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool/relation: PIT IBIT Bitcoin ETF impulse may identify crypto operating equities with genuine underlying asset-flow support, improving next-open 10-day default-off replacement value beyond generic momentum.
interpretation: The IBIT crypto-equity relation source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). Do not promote or tune this fixed Bitcoin-anchor theme relation bundle on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT crypto-flow evidence (for example spot/futures basis, stablecoin flow, borrow/options confirmation, operating hash-rate/power-cost provenance, or closed forward replacement-value rows), not a sweep of IBIT lookbacks, IBIT thresholds, crypto ticker lists, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping IBIT lookbacks, Bitcoin-anchor thresholds, crypto ticker lists, QQQ-vs-SPY threshold, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Need materially richer PIT crypto-flow, borrow/options, spot/futures basis, operating hash-rate/power-cost provenance, or closed forward replacement-value rows before revisiting IBIT crypto-equity relation leadership.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta -0.0286; aggregate PnL delta $+1,942.57; max drawdown drift +0.0013; 36 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected. IBIT Bitcoin-anchor plus crypto-equity leadership did not add robust replacement value versus the accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration checks (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The relation likely relabels crowded crypto theme beta rather than a distinct asset-flow edge.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/relation: PIT IBIT Bitcoin ETF impulse may identify crypto operating equities with genuine underlying asset-flow support, improving next-open 10-day default-off replacement value beyond generic momentum.

2_history_check.exp-20260619-021: Rejected TLT rate-relief growth leadership used duration/rate context. This run does not use rates or broad growth proxies as the anchor.
2_history_check.exp-20260620-001: Rejected uranium/nuclear relation leadership used a fixed theme basket. This run uses a different underlying-asset ETF anchor and crypto operating-equity universe.
2_history_check.exp-20260621-011: Rejected proxy-residual idiosyncratic leadership used available equity/ETF proxies. This run uses a specific Bitcoin ETF anchor and a fixed crypto operating-equity candidate set.
2_history_check.important_boundary: This run does not re-slice accepted helper allocator rows, risk intensity leads, SEC text, Companyfacts, FINRA, or Moomoo data.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: Novelty gate warned on generic OHLCV relation families. The override declares a new evidence axis: PIT IBIT Bitcoin ETF OHLCV anchor with crypto operating equities.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior relation alpha worked only when the relation itself supplied replacement value; IBIT/BTC-flow is a genuinely different PIT OHLCV anchor from prior rate, commodity, uranium, defensive, or proxy-residual scouts, but fixed theme baskets often fail concentration and accepted-comparator gates.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing IBIT/QQQ/SPY OHLCV, failed Bitcoin-anchor context, missing candidate OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $5 and ADV20 >= $20M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same IBIT Bitcoin-anchor context, crypto-equity confirmation, SPY/QQQ-relative leadership gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
